Easy banana bread 🍞

INGREDIENTS
✔️ 3 ripe bananas
✔️ 100g melted butter
✔️ 150g sugar
✔️ 1 egg
✔️ 1 ½ cups flour
✔️ ½ tsp baking soda

DIRECTIONS
1. Mash the bananas and stir in the butter.
2. Mix in the sugar and egg, then fold in the flour and soda.
3. Pour into a loaf tin and bake at 175C for 55 minutes.

#bananabread #baking
